title: Innokin Trine SE Pod Vape Kit
description: The Innokin Trine SE Pod Kit continues Innokin's tradition of delivering high-quality, versatile vape kits in a sleek and portable design. Built for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, the Trine SE features a replaceable 1000mAh battery, ensuring you can keep vaping throughout the day without waiting for a full recharge. Additionally, its 25W maximum output and airflow control options let you personalise your vape to your exact preferences, whether you enjoy tight, restricted draws or more open airflow. One of the standout features of the Innokin Trine SE is its innovative EcoDrain™ replaceable battery system. Designed with sustainability in mind, the EcoDrain™ technology allows you to discharge the battery safely and easily before recycling it. Once the 1000mAh battery reaches the end of its life, you can replace it without needing to discard the entire kit, reducing waste, and extending the life of your device. This eco-friendly solution minimises the risk of fire hazards during disposal, contributing to a cleaner, greener vaping experience. The Trine SE is compatible with Innokin’s innovative VCAP pods , which are designed with built-in mesh coils to deliver maximum flavour and vapour production. You can choose between three pod resistances – 0.6ohm, 0.8ohm, and 1.2ohm – making the Trine SE suitable for both freebase and nicotine salt e-liquids. The pods also feature a top-fill system for mess-free refills and a clear pod design to easily monitor your e-liquid levels. One of the key highlights of the Trine SE is its ease of use. With its button-free design and puff-activated firing mechanism, simply inhale to vape. The three-level battery indicator keeps you informed of your battery status, so you’ll never be caught off guard without power. Charging is fast and convenient via USB-C, ensuring minimal downtime. For even greater flexibility, the Trine SE can be used with Innokin’s Power Hub (sold separately), allowing you to charge multiple batteries simultaneously. Pod Details: Innokin Vcap 0.4ohm Pod is NOT compatible with this kit We Recommend using 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquid with this kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
